name: 초요소녀 리리나 2 (Choyo Girl Lilina 2)
detailed_description:
This game cannot be cleared if you are addicted to dopamine.

However, with just a bit of perseverance, you may temporarily free yourself from dopamine addiction.

Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is a game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl.

At the age of 13, she was rescued by a special forces unit and began working as a magician.
To become a stronger magician, she travels from village to village, training and gaining experience.

Guided by a secret agent from the first village, she moves on to the next village.
Helping villagers with their troubles will earn her rewards, allowing her to purchase better items.

Experience Lilina as she overcomes hardships, defeating wrongdoers and dangerous creatures!

Supports subtitles in Korean, English, Japanese, Turkish, German, and Indonesian.
Basic voice acting is available in Korean, English, and Japanese.

Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG where you embark on an adventure and enhance Lilina's abilities.

If you encounter an enemy too strong to defeat, level up and purchase better equipment to overcome the challenge!

Controls:

""" Press the Page Up (PU) key to view your current tasks """
Move: Arrow Keys
Select: Spacebar
Menu: ESC Key

★ If you have no idea what to do, read this ★

Pressing the Page Up key will show you what you need to do at the moment.

If you waste money by going to the academy from the beginning, the game may become difficult.
You should first explore every area of the map, earn money, equip basic armor and weapons,
and then enter the academy.

At the beginning, it’s a good idea to find treasure chests in the village
or clear missions from villagers that are nearby and use the rewards
to prioritize setting up your armor.

If the stamina gauge at the bottom right runs out, it’s game over.
You can restore stamina to 100% by sleeping at an inn.

Stamina increases as your level increases,
so leveling up lets you explore the map more freely.

If you can’t defeat strong enemies in Phase 2 or 3,
it may be more efficient to defeat them one at a time with single-target spells instead of area spells.

If you proceed to the next map without being able to handle the strongest enemy in the current map,
you may be in trouble. It’s recommended to level up until you can easily defeat the strongest enemy
before moving on.

It might seem difficult at first, but once you get used to the general flow,
you’ll find it’s not too hard to clear.

short_description: Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl. Embark on an adventure through various villages, hunt monsters, and purchase better items from shops.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS10
  • Processor: INTEL PENTIUM GOLD
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated motherboard graphics
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated motherboard sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS10
  • Processor: INTEL I3 8100
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GEFORCE GTX750
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated motherboard sound
